import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# Average several perception calls to reduce ~1cm noise
def avg_pose(fn, name, n=10):
    ps, qs = [], []
    for _ in range(n):
        p, q = fn(name)
        ps.append(p); qs.append(q)
    p = np.mean(ps, axis=0)
    q0 = qs[0]
    qs = [q if np.dot(q, q0) >= 0 else -q for q in qs]
    q = np.mean(qs, axis=0); q = q / np.linalg.norm(q)
    return p, q

def wxyz_to_rot(q):
    return R.from_quat([q[1], q[2], q[3], q[0]])

goto_home_joint_position()
open_gripper()

# Perceive nut center and handle grasp pose (before moving nut)
nut_pos, nut_quat = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = avg_pose(sample_grasp_pose, "extruded handle of the brown square nut")

# Fixed rigid offset from handle grasp to nut center, expressed in the grasp (EE) frame
R_g = wxyz_to_rot(grasp_quat)
offset_g = R_g.inv().apply(nut_pos - grasp_pos)

# Grasp the handle
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift
lift_pos = grasp_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.15])
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Perceive peg
peg_pos, peg_quat = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "brown square block")

# Target: nut center directly above peg, keeping the grasp orientation.
# EE position = desired nut center - R_g * offset_g
target_nut_center = peg_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
ee_target = target_nut_center - R_g.apply(offset_g)

# Move above peg, then insert with approach from above
goto_pose(ee_target, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.15)

open_gripper()
goto_pose(ee_target + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.15]), grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
